en.Estancia de tres meses: busco grupo con: Three-month stay: seeking a group with an annotated diachronic corpus
en.Necesito los tres meses fuera para la me: I need the three months abroad for the international doctorate mention, and I want them to count: I am looking for a group whose annotated corpus lets me validate the textual-genre control I propose.
en.grupo con corpus histórico anotado por g: group with a corpus annotated by textual genre, willing to sign the acceptance letter
en.Llevo la línea base entrenada sobre corp: I already have the baseline trained on a Spanish corpus. What I cannot do here is test it against an independently annotated corpus, which is the only thing that separates real drift from sampling bias.
en.Línea base de embeddings diacrónicos, co: Diachronic embedding baseline, an in-house 1450–1900 corpus with genre metadata, and the evaluation notebook.
en.Conectividad larvaria en el Mediterráneo: Larval connectivity in the western Mediterranean: seeking a host institution
en.Tengo la tesis empezada y director en Ba: The thesis is under way with a supervisor in Barcelona. What is missing is the partner group contributing biophysical dispersal modelling, and a doctoral programme that accepts a cotutelle.
en.grupo con modelización biofísica de disp: group with biophysical dispersal modelling and a doctoral programme that accepts cotutelle
en.La hipótesis es que los corredores de co: The hypothesis is that connectivity corridors between marine reserves do not match those predicted by the mean hydrodynamic model, because three-day wind episodes concentrate transport. I propose coupling the dispersal model to the hourly wind series rather than to the monthly mean.
en.Serie de reclutamiento de 6 reservas (20: Recruitment series from 6 reserves (2018–2025), genotyping of 1,400 individuals, and the coupled model code already running with mean forcing.
en.Las series de biodiversidad de arrecife: Reef biodiversity series are almost always analysed as annual means, which erase short bleaching episodes. I want to test whether a hierarchical approach recovers that signal.
en.especialista en modelos bayesianos jerár: specialist in hierarchical Bayesian models for time series
en.La hipótesis es que la varianza intraanu: The hypothesis is that within-year variance, not the mean, is what predicts community collapse twelve months later. I propose a hierarchical model with site effects nested within reef and a heavy-tailed likelihood for extreme episodes.
en.Censos visuales propios de 11 arrecifes: In-house visual censuses of 11 Caribbean reefs (2009–2025, unpublished), with hourly in-situ temperature and the observers' calibration notebook.
en.Un fondo monástico inédito de unos 400 f: An unpublished monastic collection of some 400 folios that nobody has transcribed. The question is whether it allows the shift from Visigothic to Caroline script in the north-west of the peninsula to be dated.
en.La hipótesis es que el cambio de escritu: The hypothesis is that the change of script was not gradual but follows the arrival of three specific scribes, identifiable by ductus features. I propose dating by hand, not by document.
en.Digitalización completa del fondo en alt: Full high-resolution digitisation of the collection, a codicological record per folio, and the partial transcription (63 folios) I have already completed.
en.Deriva semántica en corpus diacrónicos d: Semantic drift in diachronic corpora of Spanish
en.Los métodos de deriva semántica se han p: Semantic drift methods have been tested almost exclusively on English. I want to know whether the changes they detect in Spanish are real or artefacts of imbalance in historical corpora.
en.especialista en corpus históricos con cr: specialist in historical corpora with philological, not merely computational, judgement
en.La hipótesis es que buena parte de la de: The hypothesis is that much of the drift detected by diachronic embeddings in Spanish reflects shifts of textual genre within the corpus, not semantic change. I propose a control stratified by document type.
en.Corpus compilado de 1450–1900 con metada: A compiled 1450–1900 corpus with textual-genre metadata and the embedding baseline already trained.
en.Reconstrucción de olas de calor preinstr: Reconstructing pre-instrumental heat waves from agricultural archives
en.Las fechas de vendimia y siega de los ar: Grape-harvest and reaping dates in municipal archives are an unexploited proxy thermometer for extreme episodes before 1850.
en.especialista en dendrocronología para ca: dendrochronology specialist to calibrate the signal against tree rings
en.La hipótesis es que la dispersión entre: The hypothesis is that the spread between neighbouring municipalities in harvest date measures the intensity of the heat episode better than the mean date, which is what has been used so far.
en.Base de datos propia de 9.400 fechas de: An in-house database of 9,400 harvest and reaping dates (1420–1874) from 61 municipalities, already georeferenced and normalised.
en.Efecto de las ferias medievales en la pe: The effect of medieval fairs on the persistence of local markets
en.Una intuición sin desarrollar: los munic: An undeveloped intuition: towns granted a fair before 1400 still show higher retail density today. Whether that is causal or plain geography remains untested.
en.economista con experiencia en identifica: economist experienced in causal identification with historical data
en.Consorcio para HORIZON-CL6-2026-BIODIV-0: Consortium for HORIZON-CL6-2026-BIODIV-02 · Resilience of Atlantic small-scale fisheries
en.Consorcio en formación para la convocato: Consortium being assembled for the marine biodiversity call. Coordination and sampling are covered; socio-economic modelling and fleet engagement are still open.
en.líder de WP4 (modelización socioeconómic: WP4 lead (socio-economic modelling) and WP5 partner (fleet engagement)
en.El ángulo del que partimos es que la res: Our starting angle is that the resilience of the small-scale fleet depends more on gear diversification than on quota size. The proposal articulates three field work packages and two synthesis ones, with an explicit comparison between regions with and without co-management.
en.Borrador de propuesta (Parte B, 18 págin: Draft proposal (Part B, 18 pages), preliminary budget per partner and letters of interest already signed by two fishers' guilds.
en.ONG, cofradía u organización de producto: NGO, fishers' guild or producer organisation
en.Ya analicé las capturas de arrastre en G: I have analysed trawl catches in the Great Sole Bank: looking for someone to repeat the same analysis in their own fishing ground
en.Tengo hecho y cerrado el análisis de CPU: I have completed the CPUE analysis for FAO area 27.VII with a Spanish fleet under EU TAC. I am offering the full protocol to anyone who applies it as-is in their own area and fleet: their result becomes the counterfactual to mine.
en.equipos con datos de desembarque y obser: teams with landing data and on-board observers willing to repeat the same protocol in their own fishing ground
en.La hipótesis es que el régimen de cuotas: The hypothesis is that the quota regime explains more variance in standardised CPUE than the oceanographic conditions of the fishing ground. My series alone cannot separate them: at least one replication under a different regulatory regime is needed, keeping gear and window identical.
en.Protocolo completo de estandarización pa: The full step-by-step standardisation protocol, the R code fitting the GLM, a data-entry template, and my cleaned Great Sole series so you can check your implementation against mine before running it.
en.Estandarización de CPUE mediante GLM con: CPUE standardisation by GLM with nominal effort corrected for engine power, over monthly landings by trip and target species.
en.CPUE estandarizada estable pese a un des: Standardised CPUE stable despite an 18% drop in nominal effort. Without a replication there is no way to tell whether that is down to the regulation or to the fishing ground.
en.Cualquier caladero bajo un régimen de cu: Any fishing ground under a quota regime other than the EU TAC. The European replications confirm the protocol travels well, but they all share the same regulation: without stepping outside it, the central question goes unanswered.
en.Autoría para cada equipo que complete un: Authorship for every team completing a replication with at least 24 months of series. First authorship to the originating team on the joint paper; each replication keeps the right to publish its own case separately, citing the protocol. A four-person writing group.
en.Microplásticos en playas: protocolo únic: Microplastics on beaches: one shared protocol with a simultaneous start in March 2027
en.Nadie ha ejecutado esto todavía. Buscamo: Nothing has been run yet. We are looking for sites willing to sample with one shared protocol in the same four-week window, so that differences between beaches are not differences of method.
en.grupos con acceso a playa y capacidad de: groups with beach access and dry-sieving capacity, at any latitude
en.La hipótesis preregistrada es que la car: The pre-registered hypothesis is that microplastic load scales with coastal population density within a 50 km radius, and that the relationship flattens above a certain latitude. It can only be tested with simultaneous sampling: if each site samples in its own season, seasonal variation is confounded with latitudinal variation.
en.Protocolo de muestreo y tamizado paso a: Step-by-step sampling and sieving protocol, recording template, inter-laboratory calibration material, and the analysis script already written against simulated data.
en.Acceso a playa en la ventana acordada: Beach access within the agreed window
en.Modelo mixto con sitio como efecto aleat: Mixed model with site as a random effect and coastal population density, latitude and their interaction as fixed effects. Primary contrast: the interaction term. Exclusions, transformations and stopping rule fixed in advance.
en.Acceso a playa arenosa en la ventana de: Access to a sandy beach within the March window
en.Participar en la calibración inter-labor: Take part in the prior inter-laboratory calibration
en.Sitios tropicales y subárticos. Los temp: Tropical and subarctic sites. Temperate ones are already covered: one more site in the temperate Atlantic adds nothing to the latitudinal contrast, which is the question.
en.Autoría para todo sitio que complete el: Authorship for every site that completes the sampling and delivers the data in the agreed format. Alphabetical order with a rotating writing group; first and last authorship decided by the coordinating committee before the start, not after seeing the results.
en.Trabajo con cronologías de anillos de la: I have worked with tree-ring chronologies from the northern slope of the Alps since 2016. I hold calibrated series overlapping your window.
en.He vaciado archivos municipales del vall: I have combed municipal archives in the Duero valley for another project and could extend your database with roughly 1,200 more seventeenth-century records.
en.Modelos generativos aplicados a datos óm: Generative models applied to single-cell omics data
en.Cálculo ab initio a gran escala con acce: Large-scale ab initio computation with in-house cluster access
en.Transcripción y datación de escrituras a: Transcription and dating of early medieval Iberian scripts
en.Corpus históricos del español con contro: Historical corpora of Spanish with philological source control
